mechanism: Ranolazine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and valproate may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing ranolazine plasma concentrations; both drugs also have CNS effects and valproate can cause cardiac conduction changes.
action: Monitor for ranolazine toxicity signs (dizziness, QT prolongation); consider baseline and periodic ECG monitoring; dose adjustment of ranolazine may be necessary if combined therapy is essential.
